description: Normalized catalog of Pokemon Ribbons, including their origin generation, origin games, acquisition requirements, transfer behavior, and HOME title where applicable.

source.note: The source total includes nine deprecated Ribbon data slots. Ribbons are grouped only when every member shares the same origin and acquisition pattern. The source's stated per-generation subtotals count the gold Contest Memory and Battle Memory visual variants separately, which makes those subtotals add to 117 rather than its stated total of 115.

scope.included: Core-series Ribbons, transferable GameCube side-series Ribbons, event Ribbons, and deprecated Ribbon data slots listed by Bulbapedia.
scope.excluded: Pokemon HOME challenges, Marks, and spin-off-only Ribbons without a documented transfer path to Pokemon HOME.
scope.memory_conversion: Generation III and IV Contest and Battle Tower Ribbons are individually retained through Generation V, then collapse into a Contest Memory Ribbon or Battle Memory Ribbon when transferred to Generation VI.

ribbon_groups.acquisition: Enter the Hall of Fame after defeating the Pokemon League.

Win the named Hoenn Pokemon Contest category and rank. Normal, Super, and Hyper rank contests are in Verdanturf, Fallarbor, and Slateport in Ruby/Sapphire; Emerald uses Lilycove for all ranks. Master Rank is in Lilycove.
Win a seven-battle set that extends the relevant Hoenn Battle Tower streak to 56 or more wins.
